answer.reason: The verses tell of Herod's troubled inquiry of the wise men and his slaughter of the children of Bethlehem.

clauses.english: was troubled at the news of a newborn King and questioned the wise men about the star
clauses.quote: Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled

clauses.english: slew all the children in Bethlehem two years old and under
clauses.quote: sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem

doubts: ACT 23:35 names Herod's judgment hall, probably another Herod's building; left out.
MAT 2:22 only names Herod as Archelaus' father, already in the summary.
